editor.label: Editor
editor.about: Change a mix song by song: reorder, add, remove, swap and clear.

editor.suggestions.label: Song suggestions
editor.suggestions.about: Songs suggested for a spot before you search, each saying how it would hand over.

editor.locks.label: Locked songs
editor.locks.about: A locked song stays where it is when the mix is rebuilt.

seam_inspector.label: Transition inspector
seam_inspector.about: Pick the move for any transition, hear it, render it and see its checks.

seam_inspector.exact_cues.label: Exact cues
seam_inspector.exact_cues.about: Choose the exact bars and phrase a transition leaves and lands on.

stem_studio.label: Stem Studio
stem_studio.about: Both songs' voice, drums, bass and melody on one grid, heard instantly.

stem_studio.auto_arrange.label: Studio arranging
stem_studio.auto_arrange.about: Selecta arranges the stems itself, or fine-tunes yours, and says what changed.

export.label: Export
export.about: Save the whole mix as an audio file, with a list of exports.
